description_head: The Lash Sensational Sky High Mascara from Maybelline New York ensures extreme length and full volume eyelash for eyelashes. Thanks to the new formula, which contains bamboo extract and fibres, the eyelashes are strengthened and also look a lot longer - for a stunning eyelash look. Thanks to the Tower Flex brush, each lash is individually wrapped in the formula, from the root, making the eyelashes look longer and more voluminous. The black mascara easily grips every lash thanks to the Tower Flex brush. This Sky High technology ensures a sensational eye impact. For intensively longer eyelashes and a perfect eye make-up - all day long. Tip: For even longer hold of the mascara, apply the Lash Sensational Primer beforehand.
features: Sky High mascara in black for volume and length, for a stunning eyelash look and perfect eye make-up
Results: Extremely longer-looking eyelashes with full volume and curve just like after eyelash extensions
Directions for use: Apply the mascara from root to tip, repeat multiple times for a stronger effect
Fibre formula enriched with bamboo extract, flexible tower flex brush to reach every lash from any angle
